name: Accutane for looksmaxxing

lead: In looksmaxxing circles, Accutane (isotretinoin) is promoted as a skin tool: clear skin is described as a major factor in how attractive a face looks, and isotretinoin is the strongest acne treatment. A looksmax.org guide credits influencer attention to the drug and argues acne is a top facial halo.

Isotretinoin was approved for medical use in 1982 and is prescribed mainly for severe acne. The community discussion adds personal accounts of clearing, relapse after stopping, and debate about side effects.

paras: Users describe getting a dermatologist prescription with bloodwork, taking it for many months, and seeing skin clear; some discuss lower-dose approaches. This wiki gives no dosing guidance.

Isotretinoin causes birth defects and the US requires iPLEDGE; side effects include dryness, sun sensitivity, muscle and joint pain, and liver and lipid changes; mood effects are reported and debated. A boxed warning exists in the US.

angle.text: For people with acne, isotretinoin is used to clear the skin, which looksmaxxers treat as a base layer of facial attractiveness.

lead: Accutane was Roche's brand of isotretinoin, a vitamin A-related retinoid approved in 1982 for severe acne [1]. In looksmaxxing, it is discussed as a way to clear acne, which some members rank as the most important facial halo [2].

The central looksmax.org guide recounts a dermatologist-supervised course that left the author's skin clear, followed by acne returning after stopping; replies say side effects like photosensitivity, joint pain and cholesterol rise are common even at low dose, while others say effects are overstated [2].
infobox: Accutane (Roche, discontinued in US 2009); Roaccutane elsewhere [1]

paras: Isotretinoin is used for persistent cystic acne and moderate acne unresponsive to antibiotics, and many dermatologists also use it for milder scarring or distressing acne [1].

Common effects include dry lips, dry or fragile skin, dry eyes and sun sensitivity; less common are muscle and joint pain, headaches and GI symptoms; liver damage is possible so monitoring is advised; some effects such as eye and bone changes may be permanent [1]. It causes birth defects, so pregnancy must be excluded, and in the US iPLEDGE has governed dispensing since March 2006 [1]. Depression, anxiety and irritability are reported, a US boxed warning has existed since 2005, and the link to mental illness remains controversial [1].
A looksmax.org thread argues acne is the most important facial halo and mentions an influencer, 'K shami', who reportedly said he used it for years [2]. Replies disagree about side effects [2].
No studies found on the looksmaxxing framing; clinical trials of isotretinoin for acne are covered in its main article [1].

lore.intro: Members describe Accutane as an acne fix with divergent views on side effects [2].

claims.claim: Acne is the most important facial halo and Accutane fixes it
